## Checklist

- [ ] The file is at `repos/<first character>/<slug>.toml`, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
- [ ] The project is open source and its code is public at `repository`
- [ ] The description is the project's own or in my own words, not copied from another directory
- [ ] `category` is one id from `categories.toml`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes (CI runs it too)
